de.adata_about_text:

Neben der Consumer-Marke ADATA und der Gaming-Marke XPG betreibt das Unternehmen die Sparte ADATA Industrial, die robuste Speicherlösungen für Automatisierung, Embedded-Systeme, Transport, Medizintechnik, Netzwerk und Videoüberwachung entwickelt. Für die industrielle Instandhaltung (MRO) ist vor allem diese Industrie-Produktlinie relevant.

de.brand_faq_q5: Was unterscheidet A-DATA Industrial von A-DATA Consumer-Produkten?
de.brand_faq_a5: Laut Hersteller verwenden ADATA Industrial-Produkte industrietaugliche NAND-Flash-Bausteine, Controller und Power-ICs, die für −40 °C bis 85 °C validiert sind, und bieten Funktionen wie Power Loss Protection, Conformal Coating und eine fixierte Stückliste. Für Maschinen und Industrie-PCs empfehlen wir daher die Industrial-Varianten.
de.brand_faq_q6: Kann eine A-DATA SSD durch ein Modell eines anderen Herstellers ersetzt werden?

en.brand_h1: A-DATA (ADATA Industrial) – industrial SSDs, DRAM modules & storage as spare parts
en.brand_intro: ABCspareparts sources A-DATA Industrial storage components – SSDs, DRAM modules, memory cards and embedded storage – as spare parts for industrial PCs, HMIs, CNC controls and embedded systems across Europe. Send us the part number and quantity – we usually reply within 24 hours.
en.brand_intro_p2: We check availability of the original part – including discontinued series – and, where technically appropriate, compatible alternatives with the same form factor, interface and temperature range. This page is not a live stock list: please use the non-binding request.
en.adata_about_text:
ADATA Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in May 2001 by Simon Chen and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan. The company is listed on the Taipei Exchange (TPEx: 3260) and describes itself as the world's second-largest DRAM module provider, holding more than 500 NAND flash-related patents.

Alongside the consumer brand ADATA and the gaming brand XPG, the company runs ADATA Industrial, which develops rugged storage for automation, embedded systems, transportation, medical, networking and video surveillance. For industrial maintenance (MRO), this industrial product line is the most relevant.
en.adata_products_title: A-DATA Industrial product families we source
en.adata_products_intro: Typical requests cover the following product groups (example series from the manufacturer catalogue):
en.adata_products_list:
• 2.5" SATA SSD – e.g. series ISSS316, ISSS332, ISSS333, ISSS31C, ISSS31D
  • M.2 2280 SSD (SATA and PCIe NVMe) – e.g. IM2S3168, IM2S3338, IM2P33F8, IM2P41F3, IM2P41E8
  • M.2 2242 SSD – e.g. IM2S3334, IM2S3134N, IM2S3164
  • mSATA and Half-Slim SSD – e.g. IMSS316, IMSS332
  • CFast and CFexpress cards for controllers, panel PCs and cameras
  • Industrial SD and microSD cards
  • Embedded storage – eMMC and BGA SSD
  • DRAM modules – DDR4/DDR5 SO-DIMM and U-DIMM, also in ECC versions
  • Industrial USB storage
en.adata_tech_title: Temperature grades and technology – what matters for a replacement
en.adata_tech_list:
• Temperature grades: standard 0 °C to 70 °C, extended −20 °C to 75 °C, industrial wide-temp −40 °C to 85 °C. A replacement should cover at least the same range.
  • A+ SLC mode: higher write endurance based on 3D TLC NAND – important for continuous writes such as data logging or video.
  • Power Loss Protection (PLP): hardware and firmware protection against data loss during power failures.
  • Anti-sulfur resistors and conformal coating: optional protection against sulfur gases, moisture, dust and oil mist.
  • 30 µ gold-plated contacts, S.M.A.R.T. and lifetime monitoring for reliable contact and predictive maintenance.
  • Fixed bill of materials (BOM): validated machines often require the same component base – tell us whether an identical part is mandatory.
en.adata_apps_list:
• Industrial PCs and box PCs
  • HMIs and panel PCs
  • CNC and machine controls
  • Machine vision and edge AI
  • Video surveillance and NVR
  • Rail, vehicles and transportation
  • Medical equipment
  • Networking and telecom equipment
en.adata_request_title: This information speeds up your quote
en.adata_request_list:
• Full part number from the label (a photo of the label helps)
  • Form factor and interface, e.g. 2.5" SATA, M.2 2280 NVMe, mSATA, CFast, SO-DIMM
  • Capacity and temperature range (standard or wide-temp)
  • Device or machine the part is installed in (manufacturer and model)
  • Quantity and required delivery date
  • Original part only, or compatible alternative acceptable
en.brand_faq_q4: Does ABCspareparts also source discontinued (EOL) A-DATA SSDs and modules?
en.brand_faq_a4: Yes. We search distributors and brokers across Europe for remaining stock. If the original is no longer available, we propose – after consultation – compatible successors or alternatives with the same form factor, interface, capacity and temperature range.
en.brand_faq_q5: What is the difference between A-DATA Industrial and A-DATA consumer products?
en.brand_faq_a5: According to the manufacturer, ADATA Industrial products use industrial-grade NAND flash, controllers and power ICs validated for −40 °C to 85 °C, and offer features such as power loss protection, conformal coating and a fixed BOM. For machines and industrial PCs we therefore recommend the industrial versions.
en.brand_faq_q6: Can an A-DATA SSD be replaced by another manufacturer's model?
en.brand_faq_a6: Technically often yes, provided form factor, interface, capacity, temperature range and – for controllers – the boot image or machine builder approval match. We check the key data and tell you when an identical part is required.
en.adata_note: A-DATA, ADATA and XPG are trademarks of ADATA Technology Co., Ltd. They are mentioned solely to identify products. Product family and technical information is based on public manufacturer information (industrial.adata.com). Last updated: September 2026.

Heute ist 3M PELTOR die Marke von 3M für Kapselgehörschutz und Kommunikations-Headsets für laute und gefährliche Umgebungen – von einfachen Kapseln bis zu Headsets mit integriertem Funk, Bluetooth und pegelabhängiger Umgebungsüberwachung. PELTOR began in Sweden in 1950: founder Tore Palmaer developed hearing protection for the Swedish Air Force that also allowed communication in noise. Production was located in Värnamo. Through the acquisition of Aearo Technologies, PELTOR has been part of 3M since 2008.

Today 3M PELTOR is 3M's brand for earmuffs and communication headsets for loud and hazardous environments – from simple earmuffs to headsets with built-in radio, Bluetooth and level-dependent ambient listening. Other 3M safety products are on the 3M page.
en.bx_products_intro: Typical requests cover the following products (designations from manufacturer documentation):

  • Helmet-mounted earmuffs – helmet attachment versions, e.g. H510P3E, and X series with P3 or P5 adapter
  • Hearing protection headsets – ProTac III and WS ProTac XPI (level-dependent), LiteCom and LiteCom Plus with built-in two-way radio (e.g. PMR446), WS LiteCom Pro III with Bluetooth
  • Tactical headsets – ComTac, e.g. ComTac VIII, for authorities and military

en.bx_tech_title: What matters when replacing PELTOR hearing protection
en.bx_tech_list:
• Full type designation: the code (e.g. H540A, X4P3E, MT73H7P3E4410WS6EU) contains model, attachment (headband, neckband, helmet) and, for headsets, radio frequency and features.
  • Attenuation (SNR): a replacement must provide at least the required protection without over-protecting – the noise level at the workplace is decisive.
  • Helmet attachment: the helmet adapter (e.g. P3E) must match the helmet type.
  • Radio and Ex protection: frequency band (e.g. PMR446), analogue or digital, Bluetooth and ATEX approval for hazardous areas – Ex headsets need matching Ex batteries such as ACK082.
  • Hygiene kits matching the model: cushions and liners are model-specific and should be replaced regularly as per the user instructions to maintain attenuation.

en.meta_title: AB Trasmissioni Couplings, Solenoids & Heaters – Spare Parts | ABCspareparts
en.meta_description: AB Trasmissioni spare parts: GC/GCF flexible couplings, SAE bell housings, heaters, solenoids and stop solenoids, measurement transformers. Send the type – quote often in 24 h.
en.brand_h1: AB Trasmissioni – couplings, solenoids and heaters as spare parts
en.brand_intro: ABCspareparts sources components from AB Trasmissioni of Cento (Italy) – flexible couplings, SAE bell housings, solenoids, heaters and instruments – for motor pumps, generator sets and machines across Europe. Send us the type and quantity – we usually reply within 24 hours.
en.brand_intro_p2: We check availability of the original part and, where technically appropriate, compatible alternatives or successor models. This page is not a live stock list: please use the non-binding request.
en.bx_about_text:
AB Trasmissioni is a family-owned company based at Via del Curato 35 in Cento (province of Ferrara, Italy). It started in 1975 as AB BALBONI with the GC/GCF flexible couplings for motor pumps and generator sets. In 1985 Bruno Alberghini took full ownership, and in 2006 the company was renamed AB TRASMISSIONI SRL. In 2014 it acquired the instrument maker Eleberg Srl.

Today the range covers couplings and bell housings, heaters, solenoids and electric cylinders, measurement transformers and instruments, and diesel engine accessories such as stop solenoids, oil extraction pumps, mufflers, clutches and gear reducers.
en.bx_products_title: AB TRASMISSIONI product groups we source
en.bx_products_intro: Typical requests cover the following products (designations from manufacturer documentation):
en.bx_products_list:
• Flexible couplings – GC/GCF series with rubber ring, centrifugal clutches
  • SAE and non-SAE bell housings for engine-pump and engine-generator connections
  • Heaters – contact, fluid and air heaters, e.g. for engine pre-heating
  • Linear, rotary and holding solenoids and electric cylinders
  • Diesel engine stop solenoids, oil extraction pumps, mufflers
  • Measurement transformers and instruments, analog and digital (Eleberg)
en.bx_tech_title: What matters with AB TRASMISSIONI spare parts
en.bx_tech_list:
• Engine and pump data: for couplings and bell housings we need the engine type, flywheel/SAE size and the shaft diameter of the pump or generator.
  • Flexible element: rubber rings and elements wear – state type and hardness.
  • Voltage and duty cycle: solenoids and stop solenoids exist for 12 V and 24 V with different strokes and duty cycles.
  • Heating power: for heaters state power, voltage and connection thread.
en.bx_request_title: This information speeds up your quote
en.bx_request_list:
• Full type or part number from the rating plate (a photo helps)
  • Key technical data such as voltage, size or rating
  • Plant or machine the part is installed in
  • Quantity and required delivery date
  • Original only, or compatible alternative acceptable
en.brand_faq_q4: Does ABCspareparts also source older or no longer listed AB TRASMISSIONI parts?
en.brand_faq_a4: Yes. We check with the manufacturer as well as distributors and brokers in Europe. If the original is no longer available, we propose – after consultation – a successor model or compatible alternative.
en.brand_faq_q5: What are AB Trasmissioni couplings used for?
en.brand_faq_a5: Mainly to connect combustion engines to pumps, generators and compressors – for example in irrigation, firefighting, generator sets and railways.
en.brand_faq_q6: What else is in the range?
en.brand_faq_a6: Heaters, linear, rotary and holding solenoids, electric cylinders, diesel engine stop solenoids and, since the acquisition of Eleberg in 2014, measurement transformers and instruments.
